subject: AACC Weekly | Intercultural Fall Fest, Scary Movie Night, Game Night
text:
ASIAN AMERICAN CULTURAL CENTER | WEEKLY NEWSLETTER

UPCOMING
* Intercultural Fall Festival Week, Oct 26-29. Events across NACC, the House, AACC, La Casa, and MENACC: movies, treats, a haunted house, and pumpkin painting.
* AACC Halloween ("Scary") Movie Night, Wed Oct 28 at the AACC. Hosted by our first-year coordinators.
* AGPC (Asian Grad/Professional community) Kickoff, Wed Oct 28 at 6pm.

WEEKLY
* AACC Game Night, Wednesdays 6-7pm in the AACC Game Room.

ICYMI: thank you to everyone who came to the 45th Anniversary Gala Dinner at the Omni!

Follow us on Instagram for updates.
AACC, 295 Crown St
